sentences.text:
2. By a Press Notice [QCBS] dated 23.05.2022/Detail Notice Inviting Bid [QCBS] dated 31.05.2022,
the respondent no. 3 has invited bids for the work, "Development, Operation and Management Contract for running the newly constructed Eco Tourism Projects for tourist facilities at Dibru-Saikhowa" and the last date of submission of bids is up to 2 pm, 27.06.2022.
3.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 2 Ors on 22 June, 2022.json

sentences.text: The petitioner has been operating a House Boat at Guijan Ghat, Tinsukia since the year 2015.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 2 Ors on 22 June, 2022.json

sentences.text: The petitioner is aggrieved by the eligibility criteria of the bidder laid down in Clause 3[ii] of the bidding document whereby only those bidders who have experience in running a Registered Hotel/Guest House/Resort having restaurant or F & B services for minimum three years have been made eligible to submit the bids.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 2 Ors on 22 June, 2022.json

sentences.text: The bidding document has further mentioned that the bidders who do not fulfill the requirements need not participate in the bid process.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 2 Ors on 22 June, 2022.json

sentences.text: 4. It is the case of the petitioner that as per "the Rules for regulating grant of incentives to entrepreneur for promotion of tourism in the State of Assam", notified by the Government Page No.# 3/3 notification dated 22.06.1992, the definition 'Hotel' means and includes also house boats with or without boat suitable for accommodation of tourists, and approved by the Department of Tourism.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 2 Ors on 22 June, 2022.json

sentences.text: The petitioner has contended that the definition of ' Hotel' containing house boats in the said rules of the notification meets the eligibility criteria of the bidder for the contract- work in question.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 2 Ors on 22 June, 2022.json

sentences.text: However, house boat is not specifically indicated in the aforesaid Press Notice [QCBS] and thus, the petitioner seeking appropriate remedy has preferred this writ petition.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 2 Ors on 22 June, 2022.json

sentences.text: 5. Issue notice of motion, returnable in 3 [three] weeks.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 2 Ors on 22 June, 2022.json

Date : 22.06.2022 Heard Mr. S. Banik, learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms. S. Sarma, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for all the respondents.
opennyai_summary.facts:
The petitioner is aggrieved by the eligibility criteria of the bidder laid down in Clause 3[ii] of the bidding document whereby only those bidders who have experience in running a Registered Hotel/Guest House/Resort having restaurant or F & B services for minimum three years have been made eligible to submit the bids.
The bidding document has further mentioned that the bidders who do not fulfill the requirements need not participate in the bid process.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
4. It is the case of the petitioner that as per "the Rules for regulating grant of incentives to entrepreneur for promotion of tourism in the State of Assam", notified by the Government Page No.# 3/3 notification dated 22.06.1992, the definition 'Hotel' means and includes also house boats with or without boat suitable for accommodation of tourists, and approved by the Department of Tourism.
The petitioner has contended that the definition of ' Hotel' containing house boats in the said rules of the notification meets the eligibility criteria of the bidder for the contract- work in question.
opennyai_summary.22_June_2022__decision:
5. Issue notice of motion, returnable in 3 [three] weeks.
Mr.
Banik shall furnish requisite numbers of extra copies of the writ petition along with the annexures,
to Ms. Sarma within 3 [three] working days.

opennyai_summary.17_November_2023__decision:
Reluctantly, the matter stands adjourned as a last opportunity to the respondents to file affidavit-in-opposition in the matter.
The respondents are put to notice that in the event no affidavit-in- opposition is filed within the time allowed, the Court may invoke the doctrine of non-traverse and presume that the respondents have admitted the claim of the petitioner and pass appropriate orders on the next date.
Interim order passed earlier stands extended till the next date of listing.
